mapper.select:
select id, slug, status, visibility, consumes_membership_quota, city_code, address_visibility, event_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, cover_image_url, created_at, updated_at from cm_events e
order by e.event_date asc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select id, slug, status, visibility, consumes_membership_quota, city_code, address_visibility, event_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, cover_image_url, created_at, updated_at from cm_events where id = #{id} limit 1

select id, slug, status, visibility, consumes_membership_quota, city_code, address_visibility, event_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, cover_image_url, created_at, updated_at from cm_events where id = #{id} limit 1 for update

select eai.id, eai.agenda_time as time, eai.sort_order as sortOrder, lf.field_name as fieldName, lf.value from cm_event_agenda_items eai left join cm_event_agenda_item_localized_fields lf on lf.agenda_item_id = eai.id and lf.status = 'ready' and trim(lf.value) != '' and lf.field_name in ('title', 'description') where eai.event_id = #{eventId} order by eai.sort_order, lf.field_name, case lf.locale when #{locale} then 0 when 'zh' then 1 when 'en' then 2 else 3 end

select id, user_id as userId, event_id as eventId, status, requested_at as registeredAt, confirmed_at as confirmedAt, attended_at as attendedAt, event_quota_consumed_at as eventQuotaConsumedAt, event_quota_released_at as eventQuotaReleasedAt from cm_event_registrations where user_id = #{userId} and event_id = #{eventId} limit 1

select id, user_id as userId, event_id as eventId, status, requested_at as registeredAt, confirmed_at as confirmedAt, attended_at as attendedAt, event_quota_consumed_at as eventQuotaConsumedAt, event_quota_released_at as eventQuotaReleasedAt from cm_event_registrations where user_id = #{userId} and event_id = #{eventId} limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into cm_event_registrations (id, user_id, event_id, status, requested_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{eventId}, #{status}, now())
mapper.update: update cm_event_registrations set status = 'requested', requested_at = now(), confirmed_at = null, declined_at = null, waitlisted_at = null, cancelled_at = null, attended_at = null, event_quota_consumed_at = null, event_quota_released_at = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status in ('cancelled', 'declined')
update cm_event_registrations set status = 'cancelled', cancelled_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status not in ('cancelled', 'attended')
update cm_event_registrations set event_quota_released_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and event_quota_consumed_at is not null and event_quota_released_at is null

update cm_user_entitlement_balances set quota_used = greatest(quota_used - 1, 0), quota_remaining = least(quota_remaining + 1, quota_total), updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and membership_id = #{membershipId} and entitlement_code = 'event_registration' and period_started_at <= now() and period_ends_at > now() and quota_used > 0 order by period_ends_at limit 1
mapper.select: select e.id, e.slug, e.status, e.visibility, e.consumes_membership_quota, e.city_code, e.address_visibility, e.event_date, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.capacity, e.cover_image_url, e.created_at, e.updated_at, r.id as registrationId, r.status as registrationStatus from cm_event_registrations r join cm_events e on e.id = r.event_id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by e.event_date desc
